headline: TROJAN WAR HERO'S GRAVE FOUND NEAR TROY?
display: This hill near Troy may be the grave of a Trojan War hero.
Ancient writers said Ajax was buried on this coast, near the town of Rhoiteion.
Now archaeologists have found rows of stones, sealed with clay, inside a mound right there.
For decades it was hidden under soil dumped for a World War II bunker.
But here's the catch: no one knows yet how old it is.
Ajax fought beside Achilles. Greek artists were still painting them together, 2,500 years ago.
So is this hill near Troy really his grave? What do you think?
